acceptance_checks.description: invoices holds exactly 18750 documents for ns=demo, one per INVOICE_HEADER row, with deterministic _id derived from INVOICE_ID (uuid5).
Exactly 149963 line items are embedded across those headers (150000 source rows minus 37 orphans); no invoice exceeds the bounded ~25-line model without being reported.
The 37 INVOICE_LINE rows whose header does not exist are written to the quarantine collection with their source keys, and are never attached to a synthesized or guessed header.
Monetary and tax amounts round-trip exactly with no floating-point drift (BSON decimal128 or scaled integers), and per-invoice line totals equal the header total to the cent.
invoices carries a $jsonSchema validator requiring the header key, a date-typed issue date, and a lines array of objects; a legacy-shaped string date is rejected with server error 121.
Recon recomputes the manifest's INVOICE_LINE checksum 88a66751f0b08b476b492105a2efc537 from the embedded lines in Atlas and matches it exactly.
Re-running the migration for ns=demo reproduces identical header counts, embedded-line counts, checksums, and the same 37-row orphan set.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Descriptions and free-text line fields are carried through byte-for-byte after decoding, with no trimming or normalization.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: A value that cannot be decoded as UTF-8 is quarantined with reason invalid_encoding and its raw bytes recorded as hex; never replaced with a substitution character.

malformed_record_policy.details: A line row with unexpected extra delimited content is written with the parsed fields and attributed in quarantine. A NULL amount, quantity, or foreign key is never defaulted to zero or to a placeholder header: the line is quarantined with a reason code.

empty_input_semantics.details: An empty source set leaves prior invoices untouched and exits zero.

planted_anomalies.description: 37 orphaned oracle.OW_BILLING.INVOICE_LINE rows must be surfaced as an exact set of 37 quarantined lines.
